texts.name: Karma
texts.biography: As the living embodiment of an ancient Ionian soul, Karma seeks a path between spiritual continuity and the demands of a wounded homeland. Her command here represents patient recovery of finite spell points. She is not a recruitable spirit clone or a universal ruler of every Ionian community. Skirmish coavailability abstracts disagreements and separate journeys.

specialty.name: Enduring Resolve
specialty.description: Recovers one additional spell point daily within native maximum mana rules.
specialty.tooltip:
{Enduring Resolve}

Daily mana regeneration +1. No immediate refill, extra combat cast or permanent growth from kills.

texts.name: Irelia
texts.biography: Irelia's family dance became a means of resistance when invasion reached her home. The burdens of a public symbol do not erase her grief or make all Ionian groups one army. She trains this project's distinct resistance recruits; their hand-held blades and ground withdrawal are not copies of her unique floating blades.

specialty.name: Resistance Standard
specialty.description: Native upgrade-aware specialty for Resistance Blades and Resistance Veterans.
specialty.tooltip:
{Resistance Standard}

Native tier-six creature specialty supplies its normal tier-dependent Attack, Defense and specialty Speed. No flying blades, extra attacks or retaliation immunity.

texts.name: Shen
texts.biography: From a northern Navori family and raised within the Kinkou, Shen serves as the Eye of Twilight, seeking balance between material and spirit realms while carrying personal losses and difficult obligations. The Kinkou are distinct from Zed's Order of Shadow. His protection becomes conventional army armor discipline rather than a global rescue teleport, invulnerability or additional commander.

specialty.name: Stand United
specialty.description: Native Armorer specialty increases the skill's existing effectiveness by five percent per hero level.
specialty.tooltip:
{Stand United}

Armorer specialty, step size 5. Scales the existing skill bonus; no five percentage points per level, spell immunity or action cancellation.

texts.name: Akali
texts.biography: Akali left the Kinkou's prescribed path to defend her people on her own terms. She retains skills learned there without becoming a member of the Order of Shadow. In this army-command adaptation her independent fieldcraft improves the ordinary Scouting skill, with no invisibility, smoke immunity or personal assassination stack.

specialty.name: Independent Fieldcraft
specialty.description: Native Scouting specialty, step size five.
specialty.tooltip:
{Independent Fieldcraft}

Scales native Scouting effectiveness by 5% per hero level with native integer rounding. No hidden-target detection, unrestricted reveal or army invisibility.

texts.name: Lee Sin
texts.biography: Lee Sin's discipline in channeling the dragon spirit follows a history of dangerous power. His blindness does not make his army blind, and his exceptional connection is not taught as a mass transformation. He instructs humble staff disciples through a native creature specialty rather than imparting limitless attacks or displacement kicks.

specialty.name: Disciplined Practice
specialty.description: Native upgrade-aware specialty for Ionian Disciples and Enlightened Warriors.
specialty.tooltip:
{Disciplined Practice}

Native tier-one creature specialty grants its normal Attack, Defense and specialty Speed. No dragon transformation or extra attack.

texts.name: Master Yi
texts.biography: Master Yi preserves the endangered Wuju tradition and seeks a future after the destruction of his community. He remains one exceptional teacher. No ordinary recruit upgrades into another Master Yi; the voluntary Protector guardians replace the retired winged spear line. His command translates discipline into the ordinary Offense skill.

specialty.name: Wuju Discipline
specialty.description: Native Offense specialty, step size five.
specialty.tooltip:
{Wuju Discipline}

Increases the existing Offense skill's effectiveness by 5% per hero level. No true damage, kill reset, extra attack or commander combat body.

texts.name: Wukong
texts.biography: Wukong's curiosity and martial ambitions led him to become Master Yi's student. His personal enchanted staff and misdirection remain unique. This adaptation expresses an unpredictable command style through the existing Luck skill; it creates no clone stack, disguised army or free additional turn.

specialty.name: Resourceful Student
specialty.description: Army Luck +1 through a fixed native bonus, subject to ordinary Luck caps.
specialty.tooltip:
{Resourceful Student}

Native hero Luck +1, independent of hero level. The starting Luck skill adds separately under the ordinary cap; Fortune and the defending Harmony Shrine remain subject to that same cap. No skill-specialty scaling, personal clone or free additional turn.

texts.name: Ahri
texts.biography: Having discovered her Vesani ancestry, Ahri now travels to find its remnants and make memories of her own while reckoning with the harm her hunger has caused. She is not a generic species template or a permanent official of every community. Her finite spell-point capacity specialty provides no mind control, consumed-soul growth or personal nine-tailed battlefield stack.

specialty.name: Gathered Memories
specialty.description: Native Intelligence specialty, step size five.
specialty.tooltip:
{Gathered Memories}

Scales the existing Intelligence skill's maximum-mana bonus by 5% per hero level. Does not refill current mana or gain permanent power from casualties.

texts.name: Yasuo
texts.biography: Yasuo's wandering follows accusation, loss and a difficult search for his own path. His wind technique becomes a bounded improvement to native Haste while he commands an army. It grants no wind wall, missile deletion, automatic airborne combo or duplicate body; his availability alongside Yone is an explicit skirmish abstraction.

specialty.name: Following Wind
specialty.description: Native Haste gains one additional Speed on eligible targets.
specialty.tooltip:
{Following Wind}

Haste specialty adds +1 Speed at all seven creature tiers. Native mana cost, mastery, targeting, duration, dispel and Slow interactions remain. No free spell action.

texts.name: Yone
texts.biography: After death and his encounter with an azakana, Yone hunts azakana that feed on negative emotions. His exceptional condition is not an ordinary resurrected military unit. Ordinary skirmish command uses a bounded native Resistance specialty; it does not detach a second spirit commander, grant invulnerability or define a shared present for every historical scene. Project-fiction cooperation hook: Yone voluntarily guides a temporary local defense to track an azakana stalking displaced families; the hunt, not service to a state, determines his aid. This is a prose-only proposal, not an implemented campaign.

specialty.name: Azakana Vigil
specialty.description: Native Resistance specialty, step size five.
specialty.tooltip:
{Azakana Vigil}

Scales the existing Resistance skill by 5% per hero level using the selected native skill rules. No unconditional spell immunity, spirit clone or independent second turn.

texts.name: Syndra
texts.biography: Syndra's power and resentment toward those who sought to contain it make her an independent figure, not a compliant regional officer. Ordinary skirmish availability is a voluntary cooperation adaptation, not obedience or agreement with every Ionian faction. Her Sorcery specialty improves finite native spell damage; rage, kills and narrative power rankings do not grant unlimited Spell Power or mana. Project-fiction cooperation hook: Syndra voluntarily fights beside local defenders who offer passage without confinement or orders, solely to remove a shared threat to her freedom; she owes no state allegiance. This is a prose-only proposal, not an implemented campaign.

specialty.name: Unbound Potential
specialty.description: Native Sorcery specialty, step size five.
specialty.tooltip:
{Unbound Potential}

Scales the existing Sorcery skill's spell-damage bonus by 5% per hero level. Native mana, immunity and targeting rules remain; no unlimited scaling or free additional casts.

texts.name: Hwei
texts.biography: Raised as Koyehn's temple heir, Hwei gives form to inner emotion through painting after the temple's destruction. His search for meaning does not make him an ally of Jhin. A limited Precision specialty abstracts careful composition into army support; the command interface grants no palette of free spells, permanent terrain painting or manufactured copies of his brush.

specialty.name: Measured Composition
specialty.description: Native Precision grants two additional ranged Attack to eligible targets.
specialty.tooltip:
{Measured Composition}

Precision specialty adds +2 to its ranged Attack bonus at all seven creature tiers. Native costs, mastery, duration, target eligibility, dispel and ranged penalties remain.

texts.name: Xayah
texts.biography: Xayah fights for vastayan survival and the restoration of magic that her people need. Her objectives do not automatically match those of human resistance leaders. Ordinary skirmish availability is a voluntary cooperation adaptation that preserves that independence. She trains this project's bow scouts through a native creature specialty; they are neither duplicates of her personal feather blades nor proof that all vastaya share one form. Project-fiction cooperation hook: Xayah voluntarily accepts a temporary pact to reopen a blocked magic-flow route for her community, without conceding Lhotlan land or serving a human state. This is a prose-only proposal, not an implemented campaign.

specialty.name: Community Defense
specialty.description: Native upgrade-aware specialty for Vastayan Scouts and Vastayan Warriors.
specialty.tooltip:
{Community Defense}

Native tier-three creature specialty grants normal Attack, Defense and specialty Speed. Does not add shots, piercing feathers, roots or extra attacks.

texts.name: Rakan
texts.biography: Rakan is a Lhotlan performer whose love and commitment to Xayah draw him into their struggle. His performance and personal plumage remain distinct from the voluntary Protector guardians. An ordinary skirmish command adaptation supplies one bounded army Morale bonus, without charm, mass healing, partner teleport or a second simultaneous commander. Project-fiction cooperation hook: Rakan voluntarily aids local families seeking safe passage while supporting Xayah's pact; cooperation ends on their own terms, not orders from a unified state. This is a prose-only proposal, not an implemented campaign.

specialty.name: Heartening Performance
specialty.description: Army Morale +1, subject to native caps and non-living exclusions.
specialty.tooltip:
{Heartening Performance}

Native hero Morale +1. Normal morale caps and ineligible creatures remain; no enemy charm, resurrection or free movement.

texts.name: Sett
texts.biography: Sett rose through Ionia's fighting pits and built a position of power in their violent business. His affection for his mother does not erase his brutality or make him a monastery leader. This skirmish commander grants a small native Attack bonus; personal grit, grapples and crowd spectacle do not become extra hero combat actions.

specialty.name: Pit Boss
specialty.description: Hero Attack +1 through a flat native primary-skill bonus.
specialty.tooltip:
{Pit Boss}

Attack +1, independent of hero level. No damage storage, suplex, retaliation immunity, income or kill scaling.
